blocks.en: D.8 Gaps without digital silence
blocks.zh: D.8 联合国 没有数字沉默的差距

blocks.en: In the main evaluation the removed span is digital silence, which the amplitude threshold of Sec. B.1 locates almost perfectly. Here we test whether the pipeline depends on the gap being digital silence. Using the same mute envelope, we fill the span with one of three kinds of audio. Room tone is assembled from the quietest 5% of 32 ms frames outside the span, with 5 ms crossfades. Comfort noise is pink noise at the 10th percentile of the frame root-mean-square level outside the span. Attenuated speech is the original speech lowered by 40 dB, the easiest case, since faint speech remains in the input by construction. All three fillers are synthetic corruptions of the existing test windows, not new recordings.
blocks.zh: 在主要评价中,去除的跨度是数字沉默,Sec.B.1的振幅阈值几乎完美地定位于数字沉默。 在这里,我们测试管道是否取决于空白是数字沉默。 使用同一个哑声信封,我们用三种音频之一填充整个时间段. 房间的声调由32米框外最安静的5%组装而成,有5米横幅. 舒适噪声是位于框架根-正方位水平10个百分点的粉红色噪声,位于跨度之外. 减速演讲是原声降低40 dB,这是最简单的案例,因为微弱的演讲仍然通过建筑在输入中. 这三个填充器都是现有测试窗口的合成腐败,而不是新的录音.

blocks.en: We define a gap as an interval in which the audio contains no speech while the mouth keeps articulating. Silero VAD v5 proposes interior non-speech runs of at least 0.256 s at threshold 0.7. A visual articulation score, 1 − P ⁡ ( blank ) − P ⁡ ( silence ) 1-P(\text{blank})-P(\text{silence}) from a viseme head on AV-HuBERT features, is smoothed over seven frames. The detector chooses the candidate with the greatest mean articulation and declares a gap only when that mean is at least 0.4. As an ablation, an audio-only detector takes the longest non-speech run (threshold 0.2, at least 0.448 s). All parameters were selected on 373 validation cuts and 99 undamaged validation windows, to maximize mean detection across the three fillers subject to at most 5% false alarms on undamaged windows, and were frozen before any test run. The chosen operating point has 4.0% validation false alarms, and no audio-only setting met the limit (9.1% at its chosen point). The true interval is used to construct the corruption and to score, never as an input.
blocks.zh: 我们把空隙定义为:在口语不断表达时音频不包含语音的间隔. 西莱罗·瓦德 v5提出在0.7阈值下至少0.256 s的内置非声波运行. 从AV-HuBERT特性上的粘膜头部的视觉表达分数,1 − P → (空白) − P → (沉默) 1- P(\text{blank})- P(\text{ silence}),通过7个帧平滑. 探测器以最平均的表达方式选择候选人,并且只在该平均值至少为0.4时才宣布缺口. 作为一种减速器,唯声探测器使用最长的非声速运行(阈值0.2,至少0.448 s). 所有参数都选在373个验证切和99个未损坏的验证窗口上,以在未损坏窗口上最多5%的假警报下,在任何试验运行前,在三个填充器上实现最大平均值检测。 所选择的操作点有4.0%的验证假警报,没有只设定音频的设定满足极限(在所选择的点上为9.1%). 真正的间隔用于构建腐败和得分,从不作为输入.

blocks.en: Table 22 : Localization of gaps without digital silence. A gap is found when the declared interval overlaps the true span with an intersection-over-union of at least 0.5. IoU and boundary error ( Edge ) are medians over the declared intervals. Digital zero is a reference for this detector, which is separate from the amplitude threshold of the main evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表22:没有数字沉默的差距本地化。 当宣布的间隔与真实的跨度相重叠,并至少有0.5的交叉连接时,就会发现缺口. IoU和边界误差(边)是所声明间隔的中位数. 数字零是这个探测器的参考,它与主评价的振幅阈值是分开的.

blocks.en: On the verified test cuts, the detector finds more than four in five of these gaps on both sets, with median boundary errors of at most 70 ms ( Tab. 22 ). On undamaged windows it declares a gap in 2.7% of 113 TalkVid windows and 9.2% of 153 VoxMM windows.
blocks.zh: 在经核实的试验截断上,探测器在两组中,发现其中五分之四以上,边界误差中位数最多为70毫秒(Tab. 22)。 在未损坏的窗户上,它宣布113个TalkVid窗户有2.7%的缺口,153个VoxMM窗户有9.2%的缺口。

blocks.en: Table 23 : Recovery with detected gaps. Exact span recovery (%) of the language model’s transcript on the 2,092 verified cuts. Decl. : share of cuts (%) with a declared gap. A missed gap counts as not recovered. Δ \Delta : difference from the true interval, with its 95% interval. On decl. : recovery on the cuts with a declared gap, using the detected interval and the true one. The first block moves the true interval by 100 ms.
blocks.zh: 表23:有发现差距的恢复情况。 在2,092个经核实的切口上,准确跨度回收语言模型的笔录(%)。 Decl. : 已宣布差距的削减比例(%)。 漏掉的缺口算不上没有恢复。 \\ Delta : 与真实间隔的区别, 其间隔为 95% 。 decl:利用检测到的间隔和真实间隔,在已宣布的间隔处恢复切口。 第一个块将真实间隔移动100ms.

blocks.en: We then build the audible context from the detected interval and run the language model of the main experiments, with no other change. Since the detected interval is used only to build this context, we score the transcript that the language model returns. With the true interval, this reproduces the R → L R\rightarrow L result of Tab. 5 a to within 0.1 points. A missed gap is scored as not recovered, which makes these numbers a lower bound.
blocks.zh: 然后我们从检测到的间隔构建出可听的上下文,运行主要实验的语言模型,没有其他变化. 由于检测到的间隔仅用于构建上下文,我们得分语言模型返回的语录. 以真实的间隔,此选项复制 Tab 的 R → L R\ 右旋 L 结果 。 5 a至0.1点之内。 错失的空隙被评为未恢复,这使得这些数字成为下限.

blocks.en: Whenever a gap is declared, recovery equals that obtained with the true interval, to within half a point for every filler and both detectors ( Tab. 23 , last column). The loss relative to the true interval therefore comes from the missed gaps and not from imprecise boundaries. Consistently, moving both true boundaries 100 ms outward or inward, or shifting the interval by 100 ms, leaves recovery unchanged to within half a point, and the detector’s median boundary error is smaller than that. Placing the gap therefore does not rely on digital silence.
blocks.zh: 每当宣布有缺口时,恢复等于按真实间隔获得的恢复,每填充器和两个探测器在半点以内(第23页,最后一栏)。 因此,相对于真实间隔的损失来自错失的缺口,而不是不精确的边界。 一致地,将真实的边界都向外或向内移动100 ms,或将间隔移100 ms,使恢复不变到半点之内,探测器的中位边界误差小于此. 因此,把差距放在一边并不依赖于数字沉默。

blocks.en: The lips also help to find the gap. On the same cuts, the detector that reads them recovers 4 to 7 points more spans than the audio-only one, and every interval excludes zero.
blocks.zh: 唇也帮助寻找差距. 在同一切片上,读取它们的探测器比只听音的1恢复4到7分,每个间隔都排除0.

blocks.en: D.9 What the language model takes from the lip reader
blocks.zh: D.9 联合国 语言模型从读唇器那里得到的

blocks.en: The language model sees the audible context and the lip reader’s N N -best list. To separate the two, we change only the list it is shown and keep everything else of the R → L R\rightarrow L row of Tab. 5 a: the cuts, the context, the gap duration and the decoding. We remove the list, replace it with the list of a window from another source video whose top hypothesis has a similar number of words, or shorten it to its first one or five hypotheses ( Tab. 24 ).
blocks.zh: 语言模型看到可听的上下文和唇形读物的N-Best列表. 为了将两者分开,我们只更改所显示的列表,并保留R → L R\右旋L行 Tab的所有其他内容. 5a: 削减,上下文,间隙持续时间和解码. 我们删除该列表,代之以另一个源视频的窗口列表,其顶端假说词数相似,或者缩短为第一个或五个假说(Tab.24).

blocks.en: Table 24 : Hypotheses shown to the language model. Exact recovery (%) of the R → L R\rightarrow L transcript on the verified silenced cuts. Δ \Delta : difference to the full list, in points, with its 95% interval, bold where the interval excludes zero.
blocks.zh: 表24:向语言模型显示的假设。 准确的恢复 (%) R ~ L R\rightarrow L 记录在已核实的静态切片上. \\ Delta : 与完整列表的差值, 以点表示, 间隔为95%, 以粗体表示, 间隔为零 。

blocks.en: On TalkVid and VoxMM, the language model cannot fill the span without the lip reader. With the context alone, or with the hypotheses of another video, it recovers almost nothing, far below the lip reader itself. It does not copy the top hypothesis either: with h 1 h_{1} alone it stays close to the lip reader, and its gain grows with the list, most of it reached with five hypotheses. Of the spans it recovers with the full list, 13% are correct in a lower-ranked hypothesis but not in h 1 h_{1} , and 9% in none of the ten. The language model thus treats the list as candidates, which it chooses among and edits using the context.
blocks.zh: 在TalkVid和VoxMM上,没有唇读器,语言模型不能填充跨度. 单凭上下文,或用另一段视频的假说,几乎一无所获,远远低于唇读器本身. 它也没有复制顶端假说:仅凭h 1 h_{1}它就接近唇形读物,其收益随列表而增长,大部分都达到了五个假说. 在全列表中恢复的跨度中,13%在较低等级的假设中是正确的,但在h 1 h_{1}中则没有正确,9%在十大中都没有正确. 语言模式因此将列表视为候选,在上下文中选择并使用上下文编辑.

blocks.en: The hard set behaves differently, as expected from its construction. Its mouths are difficult or impossible to read, so the hypotheses carry little information: the language model recovers as many spans from the context alone as with the full list, and 65% of the spans it recovers appear in none of the ten hypotheses. The same context-only input that fails on TalkVid and VoxMM thus works where the context is informative, so the drop above reflects the missing lip information and not the form of the input. This matches the behaviour reported in Sec. 5.4 : when the lips cannot be read, the context compensates.
blocks.zh: 硬盘的行为有所不同,正如建造时所预期的那样。 它的嘴很难读或不可能读,因此假说携带的信息很少:语言模型单从上下文中恢复到与完整列表一样的宽度,65%的宽度恢复在十种假说中都没有出现. 在TalkVid和VoxMM上失败的同一种上下文输入,因此在上下文信息丰富的地方起作用,所以上面的投影反映了缺少的唇语信息,而不是输入的形式. 这与第5.4节中报告的行为相符:当唇不能读取时,上下文补偿.

blocks.en: Appendix E Speech quality, speaker similarity and lip synchronization
blocks.zh: E 语音质量、语音相似性和唇语同步

blocks.en: Table 25 complements the word-level results with the quality of the generated speech. We measure naturalness with DNSMOS [ 46 ] and UTMOS [ 48 ] , lip synchronization with LSE-C and LSE-D [ 43 , 15 ] , and speaker similarity as the cosine similarity of ERes2Net [ 10 ] speaker embeddings between the output and the clean recording of the same window. ERes2Net is the speaker model used by Just-Dub-It [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 表25以生成的语音质量来补充词级结果. 我们用 DNSMOS [46] 和 UTMOS [48] 测量自然性,用LSE-C 和 LSE-D 的唇同步 [43, 15], 和 扬声器类似 ERes2Net [10] 扬声器嵌入同一窗口的输出和清洁录制之间的余弦相似性. ERes2Net是Just-Dub-It使用的扬声器模型[6].

blocks.en: We prefer it to WavLM speaker embeddings because it separates speakers far more clearly on our data. On pairs of clean test recordings, two windows of the same video reach a mean ERes2Net similarity of 0.61 and windows of different videos 0.05, whereas WavLM gives 0.89 and 0.59, and 5% of the different-speaker pairs score above 0.87 with WavLM. A WavLM similarity near 0.9 therefore does not show that two recordings share a voice.
blocks.zh: 我们更喜欢用WavLM演讲者嵌入,因为它更明确地将演讲者分开,放在我们的数据上。 在一对干净的测试录音中,同一视频的两个窗口达到平均ERes2Net的相似度为0.61,不同视频的窗口为0.05,而WavLM给予0.89和0.59,5%的不同语言的对子与WavLM的比分高于0.87. 因此,接近0.9的WavLM相似性并不表明两张录音共用一个声音。

blocks.en: Table 25 : Quality of the generated speech , pooled over TalkVid and VoxMM: naturalness (DNSMOS and UTMOS, on a scale from 1 to 5), speaker similarity to the clean recording (Spk.), and lip synchronization (LSE-C, LSE-D). For silenced speech, Spk. is measured on the silenced span alone. Bold and underline mark the best and second best method. † Only windows with successful preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 表25:生成的语音质量,在TalkVid和VoxMM上集合:自然性(DNSMOS和UTMOS,比例从1到5),发言者与清洁录音(Spk.)相似,以及唇同步(LSE-C,LSE-D). 对于沉默的言论,Spk. 仅用沉默的跨度来衡量. 粗体和下划线标记最佳和第二最佳方法。 † 只有预处理成功的窗口 。

blocks.en: Table 26 : Listening study on noisy speech. Share of judgments (%) that prefer our output ( Ours ), rate the two the same, or prefer the baseline ( Base. ), from 16 raters and 64 judgments per baseline and question. Score : mean preference from − 1 -1 (baseline) to + 1 +1 (ours) with its 95% interval over raters, bold where it excludes zero.
blocks.zh: 表26:关于噪音言论的听力研究. 偏爱我们产出(我们的),或偏爱基线(Base.)的判断比例(百分比)从每个基线和问题16个评分和64个评分中得出。 得分:指从− 1 - 1(基线)到+1 + 1(我们的)的偏好,其间隔值为95%,在排除0时为粗体。

blocks.en: For silenced speech, methods differ chiefly around the missing span, so we measure speaker similarity on that span, for the 1,586 cuts whose span lasts at least 1 s. Over the whole window it is nearly identical for F5-TTS and our method (0.878 and 0.879), since most of each window is audible speech that both reproduce. On the span, each of our rows is above both editors, significantly so (CI [ 0.009 , 0.029 ] [0.009,0.029] for the selection against F5-TTS, the closest pair). As a reference for the scale of this measure, the clean row compares the span of the clean recording with its own window. Our outputs are also the closest to the clean recordings in lip synchronization, well ahead of the editors, and UTMOS places them above the editors and LipVoicer and just below the clean recordings. DNSMOS rates most generated outputs above even the clean recordings, in both tasks, so we read it together with UTMOS.
blocks.zh: 对于沉默的言论来说,方法主要围绕缺失的跨度不同,因此,我们衡量该跨度上发言者的相似性,即1 586次切割,其跨度至少为1秒。 F5-TTS和我们的方法(0.878和0.879)在整个窗口上几乎完全相同,因为每个窗口大多都是同时复制的声优。 在跨度上,我们的每一行都高于两部编辑,显著如此(CI [0.009, 0.029] [0.009, 0.029]),用于对照F5-TTS进行选择,最接近的一对). 作为本计量尺度的参考,干净行将干净录制的跨度与自己的窗口进行比较. 我们的产出也最接近口语同步的干净录音, 远远领先于编辑, UTMOS 将它们置于编辑和LipVoicer 之上, DNSMOS将大部分生成的输出评分高于即使是干净的录音,在这两个任务中,所以我们和UTMOS一起阅读.

blocks.en: On noisy speech, the highest DNSMOS and lip synchronization scores are those of our fixed configurations G G alone and R → G R\rightarrow G . The selection and AlignDiT follow closely, and AlignDiT is the only method with a higher UTMOS. These scores rate how natural and well synchronized the speech sounds, and none of them measures whether its words are correct. AlignDiT speaks the lip reader’s hypothesis in a clean reference voice, which UTMOS rates above the clean recordings themselves, but its WER is 23.4 points higher than that of the selection on the same windows ( Tab. 13 b). It also discards the noisy input, and its speaker similarity is below that of every one of our rows. The selection is slightly below R → G R\rightarrow G in speaker similarity. This difference is concentrated in the windows where the selection mutes the input: similarity there is 0.191, compared with 0.727 when the input audio is kept. In those windows no usable voice remains in the input, and the generator infers one from the speaker’s appearance. The result is above the similarity of different speakers (0.05) and above LipVoicer, which also generates from the video alone, but well below the windows that keep the audio. Muting thus trades the recorded voice for intelligibility.
blocks.zh: 在响亮的演讲中,DNSMOS和唇同步最高的分数是我们固定配置的G G 单独和R → G R\rightarrow G的分数. 选择和AlignDiT紧跟,AlignDiT是唯一具有更高UTMOS的方法. 这些评分评分评分语音的自然和良好的同步性,没有一个评分评分评分评分评分评分评分评分评分是否正确. AlignDiT用干净的参考声音来表达读唇器的假说,UTMOS的评分高于干净的录音本身,但其WER比同一窗口的选择值(Tab. 13b)高23.4分. 它也抛弃了吵闹的输入,它的扬声器的相似性低于我们每一行的. 在扬声器相似性上,选择略低于 R ~ G R\rightarrow G. 这种差异集中在选择调音输入的窗口:相似度为0.191,而输入音频保存时为0.727. 在这些窗口中,输入中没有可用的声音,发电机从发言者的外表推断出一个声音。 结果超越了不同扬声器的相似性(0.05)和LipVoicer的相似性,LipVoicer也从视频中单独生成,但远远低于保留音频的窗口. 因此,Muting用录音的声音来换取知觉。

blocks.en: E.1 Listening study
blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 听书

blocks.en: All results so far rely on automatic metrics. To check that they agree with human perception, we also run a listening study on the noisy-speech task, in which raters compare the output of our selection with that of one baseline at a time.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,所有成果都依靠自动衡量。 为了检查他们是否同意人类的认知,我们还对喧闹的言论任务进行了一次倾听研究,在这项研究中,评测者将我们选择的输出与一次一个基线的输出进行比较.

blocks.en: Each page presents one noisy test window as three clips with the same video: the clean recording as the reference, and two restorations, ours and that of one baseline. Their order is balanced across pages and is not revealed to the rater. The rater answers three questions: “Which one says the same words as the original?”, “Which one sounds more like the same person?” and “Which one sounds cleaner and more natural?”. Each answer is one of the two restorations or “about the same”.
blocks.zh: 每页都呈现一个吵闹的测试窗口,作为三段带同一视频的片段:作为参考的清真录制,以及两个修复,我们的和一个基线的。 它们的顺序在各页之间是平衡的,没有向评估者透露。 评估者回答三个问题:“哪一个说与原文相同?” “哪一个听起来更像同一个人?” 和“哪一个听起来更干净和更自然?” 每一个答案都是两个修复方法之一或“大致相同”。

blocks.en: The study covers 120 windows of TalkVid and VoxMM, 24 for each of five baselines, across the noise conditions of Tab. 3 and the babble sources of Sec. D.2 . On these windows our output has 30.7% WER, slightly above its 27.2% on the full noisy set, so the sample is not easier for our method than the evaluation as a whole. Sixteen raters each judged 20 windows, and all of them passed two attention checks. This gives 960 judgments, and the intervals in Tab. 26 are obtained by resampling the raters. All raters gave their consent on the first page of the study, and their anonymous answers are used only to compute the statistics reported here. Because the study records no identifying information and collects only listening preferences, no ethics board review was needed.
blocks.zh: 该研究涵盖TalkVid和VoxMM的120个窗口,每5个基线24个,跨越Tab的噪声条件. 3,以及D.2系的bulble源头. 在这些窗口上,我们的输出有30.7%的WER, 略高于其27.2%的全响集合, 所以样本对我们的方法来说并不比整个评估更容易。 16名评估员每人判断了20个窗户,他们都通过了两次注意检查。 这给出了960个判决,而Tab.26中的间隔是通过对评分器进行再模拟获得的. 所有评测者在研究的第一页都表示同意,他们的匿名回答只用于计算本文中所报告的统计数据. 由于这项研究没有记录识别信息,只收集听取偏好,因此不需要道德操守委员会审查。

blocks.en: Listeners prefer our output on all three questions ( Tab. 26 ), and each of the 16 raters prefers it on average. The preference is strongest against the two enhancement models and LipVoicer. VisualVoice is the closest baseline on the words, as it is in WER ( Tab. 13 b). AlignDiT is the one baseline that listeners rate level with ours in voice and quality, where both intervals include zero. It is given a clean recording of the speaker ( Tab. 7 ) and speaks in that voice, which the automatic scores of Tab. 25 also rate highly. On the words, listeners prefer our output over it as well.
blocks.zh: 收听者更喜欢我们在所有三个问题上的输出(Tab. 26),16位评分者中每个都平均喜欢. 与两个增强型号和LipVoicer相比,偏好最强. 视觉 语音是词上最接近的基线,如WER(Tab. 13b). AligneDIT是听众在语音和质量上与我们进行比分的一个基线,两个间隔都包含0. 它得到一个干净的发言者录音(Tab. 7),并以该声音说话,Tab. 25的自动分数也很高。 在文字上,听众也更喜欢我们的产出。

blocks.en: The listeners’ judgments also agree with the automatic scoring. Across the 120 windows, the mean preference on the words correlates with the WER difference between the baseline and our output (Spearman ρ = 0.71 \rho=0.71 ). Because these judgments do not depend on any speech recognizer, the agreement supports the Whisper-based scoring used throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 听众的判断也同意自动评分。 在120个窗口中,对单词的偏好与基线和输出之间的WER差相关(Spearman ^ = 0.71\rho= 0.71)。 由于这些判决并不依赖于任何语音识别器,因此协议支持整个论文中所使用的基于Whisper的评分.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and responsible use
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和负责任的使用

blocks.en: We evaluate on 4.8 s windows with one damaged region each, and the context given to the language model is the audible part of the same window. Longer recordings can be processed window by window, but we do not study how context from earlier windows could be carried forward. The corruptions are synthetic, so that the hidden words are known and can be scored. Section D.8 extends them to gaps filled with room tone or comfort noise, but recordings damaged by packet loss, codecs or reverberation are not covered. Beyond English, we test Spanish and French on a smaller set ( Tab. 5 b), and any other language needs a lip reader for that language.
blocks.zh: 我们评价4.8s窗口,每个窗口有一个受损区域,语言模型的背景是同一窗口的可听部分。 较长的录音可以通过窗口处理窗口,但我们不研究如何将早期窗口的背景带往前. 腐败是合成的,这样隐藏的词就已知了,可以得分. D.8节将其扩展至充满房间语气或舒适噪音的空隙,但因包丢失、解码器或反响而损坏的录音不包括在内。 除了英文之外,我们还用更小的一套语言测试西班牙语和法语(Tab. 5b),任何其他语言都需要读唇语。

blocks.en: Our method inherits the limits of its components. When neither the audio nor the context carries usable information, as in a clip fully covered by loud babble, the result is bounded by what the lip reader can read ( Tab. 12 ). The selection can also follow a wrong lip reading when the lips are hard to read, as on the silenced hard set ( Sec. 5.6 ). Since the lip reader is frozen and can be swapped, a stronger one improves the result without retraining ( Tab. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的方法继承了它的组件的极限. 当音频和上下文都没有带有用的信息时,如用高音波完全覆盖的片段,结果就以唇读者能够读到的东西(Tab.12)为界。 选择也可以在唇难读时遵循错误的唇读,如在沉默的硬套上(第5.6sec. 由于读唇器被冷冻,可以互换,一个更强的读唇可以改善结果而不进行再培训(Tab. 2).

blocks.en: When the selection discards the recorded audio, no usable voice remains in the input, and the generator infers one from the speaker’s appearance ( Appendix E ). The words are restored, but the voice is then not the one in the recording. A clean recording of the same speaker, when one exists, could serve as a voice reference for these inputs, which we leave to future work.
blocks.zh: 当选择丢弃录制的音频时,输入中不再保留任何可用的声音,生成器从演讲者的外表推断出一个声音(附录E). 词虽恢复,但语音则不是录音中的一种. 如果有同一位发言者的话,对该发言者作一干净的录音,可以作为这些投入的语音参考,我们留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: The selection runs the generator six times per window ( Sec. B.2 ), so our method is suited to offline restoration and not to live use. A single fixed configuration, R → L → G R\rightarrow L\rightarrow G , needs one pass and stays close to the selection on both tasks of the standard test sets ( Tab. 5 a), which gives a cheaper operating point.
blocks.zh: 选择每个窗口运行了六次生成器(sec. B.2 ),因此我们的方法适合离线修复,而不是活化使用. 一个单一的固定配置, R → L → G R\ 右旋 L\ 右旋 G 需要1个通过,并且在标准测试集(Tab. 5 a)的两个任务上都接近选择,这使得操作点更便宜.

blocks.en: Our method generates speech for a real person, and a restored word can be wrong: the output is a reconstruction, not a recording. We therefore see it as a tool for restoring damaged recordings, archival footage and calls with the consent of the people in them. Its output should be marked as restored wherever it is shown, with the restored interval indicated when it is known, and it should not be treated as evidence of what a person said. The text that the generator speaks is derived from the speaker’s own lip movements and the audible context, since the aim is to recover what was said, not to produce new speech for a person.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法为一个真实的人生成语音,一个恢复的单词可能是错误的:输出是重建,而不是录音. 因此,我们将它视为一种工具,在其中的人同意下,恢复受损的录音、档案录像和电话。 其输出应在所显示之处标注为恢复,已知时标注恢复间隔,不得作为某人所言之证据. 生成者所讲的文字来源于演讲者自己的嘴唇动作和可听到的语境,因为其目的是要恢复所说的话,而不是为一个人产生新的演讲。
